mapper.select: select substr(add_time,1,10) as day, count(distinct id) as users from litemall_user group by substr(add_time,1,10)

select
DATE_FORMAT(t.add_time, '%Y-%m')
CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(t.add_time, '%Y'), '-Q', QUARTER(t.add_time))
DATE_FORMAT(t.add_time, '%Y')
DATE_FORMAT(t.add_time, '%Y-%m-%d')
as day, count(distinct t.id) as orders, count(distinct t.user_id) as customers, sum(t.actual_price) as amount, round(sum(t.actual_price)/count(distinct t.user_id),2) as pcr from ( select distinct o.id, o.user_id, o.actual_price, o.add_time from litemall_order o
inner join litemall_order_goods og on og.order_id = o.id inner join litemall_goods g on g.id = og.goods_id
where o.order_status in(401,402)
and ( g.category_id = #{categoryId} or g.category_id in (select id from litemall_category where pid = #{categoryId}) )
) t group by day order by day
select substr(add_time,1, 10) as day, count(distinct order_id) as orders, sum(number) as products, sum(number*price) as amount from litemall_order_goods group by substr(add_time,1, 10)

select g.id as goodsId, g.name as goodsName, cat.name as categoryName, round(avg(c.star), 2) as avgStar, count(distinct c.user_id) as userCount from litemall_comment c inner join litemall_goods g on g.id = c.value_id left join litemall_category cat on cat.id = g.category_id where c.type = 0 and c.deleted = 0
and ( g.category_id = #{categoryId} or g.category_id in ( select id from litemall_category where pid = #{categoryId} ) )
group by g.id, g.name, cat.name
order by avgStar asc, userCount desc, goodsId asc
order by avgStar desc, userCount desc, goodsId asc
